description.default: Real-time encrypt documents + all assets (images/videos/PDF/xlsx, any format) into a self-developed single-file vault (.sydb); zero plaintext (in-memory injection). Unlimited size, Argon2id KDF (OWASP-first) for new vaults, TOTP two-factor unlock, tamper/ransomware monitor, burn-after-reading one-time share, auto update check, OCR full-text image search (tesseract, CDN model), TF-IDF semantic auto-sharding, mobile read/write (PIN session), auto/incremental backup, WebDAV two-way sync, dedup, folder zip import, central vault directory, in-vault recycle bin, restore-on-remove, orphan recovery, password hints, recovery key (forgot-password recovery), weak-password detection, sensitive-info alert, revision history rollback, audit log, device-bound activation code (anti code-sharing). Paid license (WeChat nglzhy), 7-day trial.
description.zh_CN: 把选中的文档及全部附件（图片/视频/PDF/xlsx 任意格式）实时加密进一个自研单文件数据库（.sydb），工作区零明文（内存注入显示）。容量无上限；新建库默认 Argon2id 加密（OWASP 首选 KDF）、TOTP 双因素解锁、防勒索/防篡改监控、阅后即焚一次性分享、自动更新检查、OCR 图片全文搜索（tesseract，模型走 CDN 不占插件体积）、TF-IDF 语义智能分库、移动端读写（6 位访问码会话）、自动/增量备份、WebDAV 双向同步、资产去重、文件夹整包入库、集中分库目录、库内回收站、移出自动还原、孤儿找回、密码提示、恢复密钥（忘记密码可找回）、弱密码检测、敏感信息提醒、版本历史回滚、审计日志、设备绑定激活码（防一码多用）。付费授权（微信 nglzhy），7 天试用。
